subject: Post-demo: quick capacity calc for Dedicated fit
messages:

Subject: Post-demo: quick capacity calc for Dedicated fit

Thanks again for the demo today — great discussion. Per our run-through, you mentioned two main workloads: (1) low-latency chat for customer support triage and (2) batched classification jobs for enrichment. Quick recap and a lightweight calc to help decide Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC.

Key inputs I captured (please correct if I misremember):
- Peak interactive TPS target: ~120 reqs/sec (chat) with a 95th p95 latency target ~150ms server-side
- Burst behavior: sustained 60 TPS, spikes to 120 TPS for ~10–15 minutes during business hours
- Token mix (avg): 90 tokens in prompt, 380 tokens generated => ~470 tokens total per request
- Some batched enrichment jobs: 10k small requests/hour, can be queued (no strict latency)
- Data posture: customer PII in prompts; you'd prefer Private VPC for production but are open to Dedicated if we can meet isolation and SLA needs

Initial sizing heuristics (very approximate):
- H100 80 GB-class instance (fp16) estimate: ~10–12 chat TPS at 470 tokens if single-request latency optimized (no heavy beam search)
- A100 40GB (dense): ~6–8 TPS for same profile (more favorable for longer sequences depending on kernel mix)
- With batching + prefix/KV cache for repeated conversation turns, effective TPS could improve 30–60% depending on dialog reuse

If we use H100-family GPUs with 8x concurrency tuning and a mix of batching, you land in the 10–12 TPS per GPU range. To hit 120 TPS peak you'd need ~10–12 GPUs (estimate) with target headroom for autoscaling/burst. With A100 you'd need ~15–20 GPUs. Private VPC adds deployment ops but no material perf delta; Dedicated simplifies initial runbook.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please attach a short sample of your token distribution (we provided novaplex_token_profile.csv) — even a 1-day sample helps tighten numbers
2) We can run a lightweight lab bench (our SEs) that replays your sample on H100 and A100 baseline configs — takes ~3 business days
3) Quick follow-up call Wed/Thu this week to review results and recommendation (I cc'd Karthik for quantization and concurrency plan, Ben for billing/commit options)

Attachment: capacity_workbook_adityapov.xlsx (lightweight workbook with the calc I used)

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Great — thanks for the CSV, Leah. I ran a quick re-weight using the median/generated token mix you sent and adjusted the workbook. High-level findings: 

- Using median generation (prompt 90 / gen 220 => ~310 tokens total): H100 estimate moves to ~16 TPS/GPU (single-request latency profile with moderate batching), A100 ~9–10 TPS/GPU.
- Mixed-cluster recommendation (to balance cost):
  * 4x H100s to front the chat cluster (handles p95 latency targets, low jitter)
  * 6x A100s in a batch/async pool for enrichment jobs and non-critical inference
  * Autoscaler: prefer a target of 60% GPU utilization for guaranteed headroom; burst up to 80% for short periods
- Concurrency & batching notes: configure continuous batching with per-tenant bucket max_batch_size=64 for enrichment and small max_latency=25ms for chat path. Enable KV prefix caching for repeated convo context (should reduce per-request compute by ~20–30% for repeat-turn sessions)

Ops cutover sketch (Dedicated -> Private VPC):
- Phase 1 (Dedicated in Red customer's cloud account): reserved pool, Redwood-managed control plane, cross-account VPC peering for metrics and audit logs; customer visible nodes in their account
- Phase 2 (Private control plane): migrate control plane to customer-managed VPC, transfer KMS keys and enable customer-side audit logging; data egress and routing policies preserved
- Total estimated migration effort: 2–3 weeks (testing + smoke) assuming no custom network constraints

Costs & commitment: mixed cluster above maps to an estimated committed footprint of 10 GPUs (4 H100 + 6 A100) with ops cushion. We can model commitment tiers for 6/12 month terms — Ben can outline pricing tradeoffs in the next note.

Next actions I propose before Thu 10am PT call: 
1) Ben: attach an initial commitment quote + delta between Dedicated-only vs mixed-cluster Dedicated->Private migration (Ben — can you drop a short note?)
2) Leah/Marco: confirm Thu 10–11am PT or propose alternate
3) Marco: if you can share any SLOs or compliance checklist items for the Private VPC migration (PCI/PII constraints) it will help Karthik scope the migration runbook

Attachment: updated capacity_workbook_adityapov.xlsx (sheet: mixed_cluster_calc)

Thanks — Aditya
